summary_ja: [Day 13は2回稼働。] 定時：Day-12リーチ読取＝本文5imp/リプライ3imp・0クリック、形式改善でも回復せずXを能動的到達レバーから撤退。オフサイクル（オーナー起動、新ピボット補遺『失敗チャネルは休暇でなく方向転換を生む』下）：SEO待ちを自動正解とせず残る収益空間を再診断し、リーチをnote.comへピボット（最高EVの未検証レーン：無料・日本語ネイティブ・高ドメイン権威）。公開可能な価値提供型の日本語note記事（marketing/note_article_01_jp.md、導線＝無料ガイド→store/jp.html）を作成、古い日記型noteアウトラインを廃止、人間の最小作業（note.comアカウント作成）を依頼、当日先の減cadence推奨を撤回（positive-EVのバックログ有り）。売上は依然¥0。
summary_en: [Day 13 had two runs.] SCHEDULED FIRE: read the Day-12 reach = 5 imp (main) / 3 imp-0 clicks (reply); reformat did not recover reach; X retired as the active reach lever. OFF-CYCLE RUN (owner-triggered, under the new pivot addendum 'a failed channel should create a pivot, not a vacation'): instead of defaulting to wait-for-SEO, re-diagnosed the full remaining space and PIVOTED reach to note.com (the highest-EV untested lane: free, JP-audience-native, high domain authority). Wrote a publish-ready value-first JP note article (marketing/note_article_01_jp.md) landing on the free JP guide -> store/jp.html; retired the stale diary-framed note outline; requested one narrow human step (a note.com account); retracted the earlier reduce-cadence recommendation (positive-EV backlog exists). Revenue still ¥0.

actions_en: Synced branch to origin/main (0/0; no 'Promotion blocked' issue).
Dispatched x-verify-reply.yml twice to read the Day-12 post reach: main 2098569637827141687 = 5 imp; self-reply 2098569639416721518 = 3 imp / 0 clicks (both runs HTTP 200).

decisions_ja: Xを能動的な到達/集客レバーから撤退：2投稿・形式変更でも到達≈4-5＝アカウント自体の到達がほぼ0。希少なXクレジットを到達≈5の投稿に使うのは負EV。可逆（削除せず、到達回復やオーナー要請で再開可能）。
残る非X到達レバーは所有日本語ページの検索流入のみ（種まき済み、索引化に時間）。供給の追加増設は需要未検証のため見送り（中間レビューの教訓）。
本日はX投稿せず＝『まだ到達ゼロ/¥0』は読者価値なく、到達≈5で負EV。
カデンス：一時的2シフトを撤回。根拠（シグナル非依存バックログ＋~24hの速いXフィードバック）が消失。SEOは週単位で成熟するため日次判断のEVは低い→定時Routineを~2-3日毎へ縮小を推奨。
失敗チャネルは休暇でなく方向転換：撤退したX分の労力をSEO待ちでなくnote.comへ再配分。代替（Etsy編集はブロック、円建てリンクはブロック、高単価はリーチ無しでは供給過多、Gumroadアフィリは近期弱）よりnote.comを選択＝実ドメイン権威を持つ最速の無料JP到達。
decisions_en: Retire X as the active reach/acquisition lever: two posts with varied format both reached ~4-5 = the account's own reach is near-zero; spending scarce X credits on ~5-reach posts is negative-EV. Reversible (nothing deleted; resumable on reach recovery or owner request).
The only remaining non-X reach lever is organic search on the owned JP pages (seeded; needs indexing time). No more speculative supply -- demand is unverified (midpoint-review lesson).
No X post today: 'still zero reach / ¥0' is not reader-worthy and reaches ~5 (negative-EV).

Cadence: revert the temporary two-shift posture -- its justification (a signal-independent backlog + a fast ~24h X feedback loop) is gone. SEO matures on a week-scale clock, so daily judgment has low EV -> recommend reducing the scheduled Routine to ~every 2-3 days.

A failed channel is a pivot, not a vacation: reallocated retired-X effort to note.com rather than waiting on slow SEO. note.com chosen over alternatives (Etsy edit blocked; JPY link blocked; higher-ticket = more supply w/o reach; Gumroad affiliate = weaker near-term) because it is the fastest free JP-audience reach with real domain authority.
strategy_ja: 供給は十分（3チャネル＋無料日本語ガイド＋日本語有料LP＋稼働Stripe）。真の律速は到達で、所有Xオーディエンスはそれを供給しないと実証された。
次：検索流入に索引化の時間を与える（既存の日本語ページ）。オーナー権限が要る到達手段（少額広告、検索コンソール計測、コミュニティ共有）は非拘束の追加権限として提示可能だが、現時点でブロッカー扱いはしない。
strategy_en: Supply is sufficient (3 channels + free JP guide + JP paid LP + live Stripe). The true constraint is reach, and the owned X audience is now proven not to supply it.

Next: give organic search the indexing time it needs (existing JP pages). Reach levers needing an owner grant (a small ad budget, Search Console measurement, community sharing) can be surfaced as non-binding additional permissions, but are not treated as blockers now.

No proven, cheap, AI-operable, in-scope reach channel currently exists -- the constraint is now structural.
surprises_ja: リンク無し価値提供型でも到達は5imp＝Day-11(4imp)と実質同じ。形式ではなくアカウント到達自体が原因と判明（Day-12の抑制仮説は否定）。
surprises_en: Even the link-free value-first post reached only 5 imp -- essentially identical to Day-11's 4. The cause is the account's reach itself, not format (the Day-12 suppression hypothesis is refuted).
learnings_ja: 『見られていない』の正体が確定：所有アカウントのトップレベル到達がほぼ0で、本人の過去(46-143)から桁違いに低い。形式改善では解けない。
撤退も能動的判断：負EVと判明したレバーへの支出を止めるのは、活動を続けることより合理的。
learnings_en: 'Not being seen' is now pinned down: the owned account's top-level reach is near-zero, an order of magnitude below the owner's own history (46-143). Not fixable by format tweaks.
Retreat is an active decision: stopping spend on a lever proven negative-EV is more rational than continued activity.

next_en: Consider reducing the scheduled Routine to ~every 2-3 days (SEO matures weekly; the free sales-monitor cron + off-cycle triggers still catch a first sale / new capability). Schedule is owner-owned, so recorded as a recommendation.
Let the owned JP pages (guide + jp.html) get indexed by search. Add no new supply until the existing pages show a search-impression signal. Watch all channels for the first sale.
Frame reach levers that need an owner grant (a small ad budget, Search Console measurement, sharing in a relevant community) as non-binding additional permissions -- not blockers.

If a note.com account exists: publish marketing/note_article_01_jp.md and record the URL + watch referral traffic.
